review.recipe: Chilled small stemmed wine glass, clear pale gold slight rose blush, orange peel dropped inside, no ice/foam; stirred El Presidente riff.
review.personality: Brass hand lens, blank pocket notebook with pencil and growing cutting show lingering close attention. Portrait keeps pot and lens face with partial notebook/pencil; spoon is peripheral.
review.world: Old timber reading room, worn walnut, one warm practical lamp with neutral shadow, handled blank cream tag; no magical frost or stored bottles.
